page.overview:
Who is Sydney Allen?

In Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Sydney Allen is an extreme skateboarder.

Sydney Allen is a teenage girl with long straight brown hair, black eyes, freckles, tan skin, and a thin figure. She wears a fitted red t-shirt, red-pink shorts, and green and purple knee and elbow pads. She also wears white knee-high socks with red stripes, green and purple sneakers, and a green, purple, and red skateboarding helmet.

Sydney debuted in "The Longest Fight" competing in the three-hour-long Tōkyō Extreme Skateboarding Finals. She was to perform the exceedingly advanced 14-40 trick on the Mega-Ramp which has the skater rotate mid-air four times. While she failed her first two attempts, Sydney was able to complete all the required rotations on her third and final attempt, but it is currently unknown if she succeeded in landing it as the broadcast was abruptly cut off.
